rules.statement: When a vendee sues a trespasser and the action is unsuccessful, he may still sue his vendor for damages.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now, the cases cited were mainly those of lessee against lessor or vendee against vendor, where the lessor in the one case or the vendor in the other had placed his lessee or vendee in full physical possession of the land leased or sold by him. These cases can have no application whatever to the present, because in this case, admittedly, the plaintiff was not put in possession of the land sold to him by the defendants."
